mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_event_log ( trade_seq, member_seq, event_type, payment_key, order_id, amount, method, toss_status, toss_code, toss_message, created_dtm ) VALUES ( #{trade_seq}, #{member_seq}, #{event_type}, #{payment_key}, #{order_id}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{toss_status}, #{toss_code}, #{toss_message}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM payment_event_log e INNER JOIN ( SELECT trade_seq, MAX(payment_event_seq) AS latest_event_seq FROM payment_event_log GROUP BY trade_seq ) latest ON latest.latest_event_seq = e.payment_event_seq INNER JOIN sb_trade_info t ON t.trade_seq = e.trade_seq WHERE t.safe_payment_st = 'CONFIRMING' AND ( e.event_type IN ('CONFIRM_UNKNOWN', 'CANCEL_FAILED', 'RECONCILE_REQUIRED') OR (e.event_type = 'CONFIRMING' AND e.created_dtm < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) )
